message.content:
Brain.fm appears to be a **small, privately held, revenue-generating app company** with a relatively modest funding history and a team in the **low teens to mid-teens**. Current pricing on its own site is **$14.99/month** or **$99.99/year**, with **no lifetime plan** shown on the pricing page.[1][31][33]

- **Funding raised:** Publicly surfaced sources point to only a few disclosed financing events: a **$100K seed investment from co-founders** and a **$225K NSF grant in 2018**; one profile also lists **Slow Ventures** and an angel investor among investors.[16][17][24][28]
- **Investors:** The named investors that show up in the sources are **National Science Foundation**, **Slow Ventures**, and an **angel investor** (named in one interview as **Dave Morin**).[17][28]
- **Team size:** LinkedIn lists Brain.fm as **11–50 employees**.[31] Other company databases cluster around **13–15 employees** in 2025–2026, which is consistent with a very small team.[33][35][43]
- **Business model:** Brain.fm is a **subscription app** for focus/sleep/relaxation; the pricing page says it offers a **monthly plan** and a **yearly plan**, and explicitly states there is **no lifetime plan** on the page.[1]
- **Current pricing tiers:** The official pricing page shows **$14.99/month** and **$99.99/year**.[1]

For the rest of your request, the best available public estimates and recent community sentiment are:

- **Downloads / revenue estimates:** I do not have a reliable public estimate in the gathered material from Sensor Tower, data.ai, or Appfigures to quote as a verified figure. The non-specialist company databases surfaced here suggest annual revenue is likely in the **low single-digit millions or below**, but those are **not authoritative app-intelligence estimates**, so I would not treat them as load-bearing without a direct Sensor Tower/Appfigures/data.ai source.[37][39]
- **2024–2026 news:** The strongest concrete 2024–2026 item in the material is that Brain.fm continues to emphasize its **NSF-funded research**, patented audio approach, and ADHD/focus positioning in 2025 press coverage.[25] I did not surface a clear 2024–2026 layoff, acquisition, or major pivot announcement in the material gathered here.
- **Reddit/forums sentiment in 2025–2026:** The material gathered here does not include direct Reddit threads, so I can’t responsibly attribute recent community opinions verbatim. What *is* visible from review-style/forum-like sources is a recurring split: supporters say it helps them focus or relax, while critics complain about **price**, **subscription-only access**, and inconsistent personal benefit; several comparison pieces also note alternatives such as **Endel** and sometimes position Brain.fm as relatively expensive versus rivals.[11][13][15]

A few important caveats:
- The public funding story is **not a classic venture-capital heavy story**; the disclosed financing is much thinner than many startups, and some profiles disagree or omit details.[16][17][18]
- Pricing on third-party review sites is **inconsistent** with the official pricing page, so for pricing you should treat the **official site** as the source of record.[1][4][7][11][13]
- For downloads/revenue, the missing piece is a direct app-intelligence source; without that, any numeric estimate would be too shaky to present as fact.

If you want, I can turn this into a **clean diligence memo table** with columns for **claim / best source / confidence / notes**.
